intro.name: The crisis
intro.text: A healer finds ancient writing: "Gather the leaves beneath the moon, crush them with the pale stone, and never - " The rest has worn away.

choices.label: Ask scholars and elders to examine the inscription.

variants.text:
A healer finds ancient writing: "Gather the leaves beneath the moon, crush them with the pale stone, and never - " The rest has worn away.
An Isolan elder knows the rest but demands respect for the community's knowledge before sharing it.

a1.text: The interpretation is correct and the patient recovers.

a2.text: The missing words warned against a dangerous plant.

a3.text: The supposed remedy is actually a recipe for ceremonial pigment.

a4.text: The name of a long-forgotten healer is recovered.

b1.text: A single symbol transforms the meaning of the instructions.

b2.text: Three scholars produce three incompatible translations.

b3.text: An elder recognizes the missing phrase from an old chant.
